periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, with the primary axis tilted approximately 45 degrees inward toward the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval, exhibiting a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.5.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, resulting in a teardrop-shaped morphology with a significant downward extension below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior curve transition across the interscapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, encompassing the entire shoulder girdle and extending down to the proximal limb segments.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across the cranial vertex, approximately equal to the width of the inter-ocular distance.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Strongly convex and rounded superior boundaries without visible flattening.
